text.insert: A native engine is weak in four cases. Handle them before the call, or use the BAML engine:
Arithmetic, counting, and dates. Compute them in code and put the result in the state.
Indirection. A question about a fact several steps removed from the state gets a weak answer.
Large, distracting state. Filter the slice down to what the question needs.
Adversarial text. Instructions inside the state can sway the answer.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: The question type, in Pi's vocabulary.

fields.name: choice
fields.description: The winning label of a choice, or "true" or "false" for a bool. Absent after a refusal or an engine error.

fields.name: probability
fields.description: The probability p of true. bool only.

fields.name: score
fields.description: The expected level index that Pi returns. score only.

fields.name: distribution
fields.description: Probability per label. Native choice answers only.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: For a bool, the kernel derives it as max(p, 1 - p), so 0.5 is the least sure value.

fields.description: Tells the caller whether a threshold on confidence means anything.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: BAML engine only. Native engines return none.

fields.name: checks
fields.description: Results of BAML @check rules.

fields.name: evidence
fields.description: Trace pointers that support the answer.

fields.name: abstained
fields.description: True when the answer gives the harness no verdict.

fields.description: Why the answer abstained. Set only when abstained is true.

fields.name: criteria
fields.description: Defines each choice, each score level, or the true and false meanings of a bool.

fields.name: passAt
fields.description: bool only. p at or above it passes.

fields.name: failAt
fields.description: bool only. p at or below it fails. A value between passAt and failAt abstains.

fields.name: minTop
fields.description: choice only. The top probability must reach it.

fields.name: minMargin
fields.description: choice only. The top probability must lead the runner-up by at least this much.

fields.name: abstainBelow
fields.description: score only. Confidence floor. Below it the answer abstains.

fields.name: images
fields.description: Pi image parts for engines that accept images, such as gpt-6-luna. Jev is text only.

fields.name: chosen
fields.description: The label the harness acts on.

fields.name: thresholdApplied
fields.description: The passAt and failAt, minTop and minMargin, or abstainBelow values that the kernel applied.

steps.text: Kernel mints one session (kind `decision`) and one run under `parentRunId`
Pi `classify()` answers every question in one call
Kernel compares each answer with the thresholds of its question
A clear verdict ends the flow, and the harness branches on `chosen`.
A refusal or an engine error abstains before any threshold applies.
Harness runs a BAML judge through `kernel.call` and gets a rationale
The judge records its own run, turns, and `call_start` and `call_end` events with engine `baml`.
Harness routes the decision to a human or operator when the judge is still uncertain
This outcome is a normal result, not an error.
